title: LCD1602 液晶显示
goal: 掌握 HD44780 时序：RS/RW/E 三根控制线的作用、指令与数据的区分、4 位/8 位接口，以及"写指令→等忙→写数据"的驱动流程。
doc:
实验平台（虚实结合）：本课程实物实验采用 STC89C52RC 最小系统板（京东开发板）与 STM32F407 最小系统板（京东开发板）。 本虚拟仿真实验基于上述最小系统板构建，可灵活扩展外设（LED、按键、上拉电阻、蜂鸣器、矩阵键盘、数码管、LCD1602、串口适配器等），是实物实验的有益补充——虚实结合、线上线下实验类似但不完全重复。

实验原理

LCD1602 由 HD44780 控制器驱动，三根控制线： RS（0=指令/1=数据）、RW（0=写/1=读忙）、E（下降沿锁存数据）。 数据显示在 DDRAM：第一行 0x00 起、第二行 0x40 起，各 16 字符可见。

典型写流程

E=0 → RS/RW 就绪 → 数据放 P0 → E=1 → 延时 → E=0（锁存）

接线表

LCD1602单片机
RS / RW / EP2.0 / P2.1 / P2.2
D0~D7P0.0 ~ P0.7

实验步骤

  1. 编译下载，第一行显示 Hello MCU!，第二行显示运行秒数
  2. 修改显示内容为自己的学号姓名拼音
  3. 阅读 lcd_cmd / lcd_dat，体会三根控制线的配合

思考

1. 读忙函数 lcd_wait 里为什么要先把 P0 置 0xFF？
2. 0x80 + 地址 是什么指令？第二行首地址是多少？
3. P0 为什么必须外接上拉电阻？（漏极开路，输出 1 时引脚悬空，读回无意义）
goalEn: HD44780 timing: the roles of RS/RW/E, command vs. data, the 4/8-bit interface, and the write-command → wait-busy → write-data driver flow.
docEn:
Experiment platform (virtual–physical): the physical labs in this course use the STC89C52RC minimal system board (JD.com) and the STM32F407 minimal system board (JD.com). This virtual experiment is built on the same boards and can be extended with peripherals (LEDs, buttons, pull-up resistors, buzzer, matrix keypad, 7-segment displays, LCD1602, UART adapter, etc.) — a useful complement to the physical labs: similar but not identical.

Principle

The LCD1602 is driven by an HD44780 controller with three control lines: RS (0 = command / 1 = data), RW (0 = write / 1 = read busy), E (data latched on the falling edge). Text lives in DDRAM: row 1 starts at 0x00, row 2 at 0x40; 16 characters visible per row.

Typical write flow

E=0 → RS/RW ready → data on P0 → E=1 → delay → E=0 (latch)

Wiring

LCD1602MCU
RS / RW / EP2.0 / P2.1 / P2.2
D0–D7P0.0 ~ P0.7

Steps

  1. Build and flash: row 1 shows Hello MCU!, row 2 shows the running seconds
  2. Change the text to your own name in pinyin
  3. Read lcd_cmd / lcd_dat and see how the three control lines cooperate

Reflection

1. In the busy-wait function lcd_wait, why must P0 be set to 0xFF first?
2. What instruction is 0x80 + address? What is the start address of row 2?
3. Why must P0 have external pull-up resistors? (open-drain — a pin floats when outputting 1, so reads are meaningless)
